extracted.name: Strawberry Limeade
extracted.description: This strawberry limeade is a refreshing summer cooler that's easy to make with frozen strawberries and lime juice, and even easier to enjoy!
instruction_lines: Place lime juice, cold water, sugar, and strawberries in blender and blend on high until smooth. While blender is running, add ice cubes one at a time.
